_help: Edit titles, subtitles and notes here. Each key under 'sets' matches a data-chart-set attribute in index.html. Chart fields: id, type (line|bar), title, subtitle, note (omit to use defaults.note; '' for none), alt (accessible description), indicator (set-level default; override per chart), units, groups, year (bar only). A chart with a 'views' array gets toggle buttons; each view has a 'label' and can override title, subtitle, note, alt, groups, units, type or year.

defaults.note: Source: NYC Health Department. 2024 data are provisional and subject to change.
